about.title: People helping people find their voice
about.text1: Associació Parla i Integra is an association in Reus born from a simple idea: nobody should feel alone or isolated because they don't speak the language yet. Learning Catalan and Spanish opens doors at school, at work and, above all, in friendships.
about.text2: We focus on two things: online Catalan and Spanish classes for women, and school support and language classes for children, also through schools and centres.

points.p1: We learn by talking, using real-life situations
points.p2: Everyone at their own pace, with no pressure or judgement
points.p3: A space of trust, respect and support

quote.label: What we believe
quote.text: When someone learns to say “good morning” with confidence, they also start to feel that the street, the school and the city belong to them.

language.title: Language
language.text: Speaking the language is a tool to make decisions about your own life.

community.title: Community
community.text: We build bonds between neighbours who might otherwise never meet.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: We value every culture, every language and every story that arrives.

solidarity.title: Solidarity
solidarity.text: We help each other: what is learned is shared.

scenarios.title: Language in real-life situations
scenarios.lead: We practise what you really need to say: at your children's school, at the doctor's, in a job interview or around the neighbourhood.
scenarios.chatSub: Examples of what we work on in our groups

school.t1: Good morning, I've come to pick up my daughter.
school.t3: Her name is Amina. Thank you so much!

health.t1: Good morning, I have an appointment with the doctor at five.
health.t2: Perfect. Please take a seat, they will see you shortly.

work.t1: Good morning, I'm here for the job interview.
work.t3: Thank you so much. I'm a little nervous!

city.t1: Excuse me, how do I get to the Town Hall?
city.t2: Follow this street and turn right.
city.t3: I understood! Thank you so much!

programs.title: Two ways to learn, one goal
programs.lead: Classes for women and support for children: all to build confidence with the language.

reinforcement.title: School support
reinforcement.text: We support children with homework, reading and speaking and writing, so they gain confidence in class and enjoy learning.

conversation.title: Online conversation groups
conversation.text: Speaking is the best way to learn: informal meet-ups to lose the fear.

kids.title: Catalan and Spanish classes for children
kids.text: They learn the language through play and conversation, at their own pace and with confidence.

women.title: Catalan and Spanish classes for women
women.text: Live online classes, adapted to your level and your needs.

journey.title: From first words to feeling part of it
journey.lead: Learning a language is much more than grammar: it's gaining freedom, step by step.

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: We start by understanding what we hear on the street, at school and in everyday paperwork.

speak.title: Speak
speak.text: We lose the fear of making mistakes: we talk, laugh and learn with confidence.

participate.title: Take part
participate.text: We move around independently: school meetings, paperwork, shops and job interviews.

belong.title: Belong
belong.text: We make friends, get to know the neighbourhood and find our place in Reus.

help.title: There are many ways to join in
help.lead: An association is only as strong as the people who make it possible. You can be one of them, and we'd love that.

volunteer.title: Become a volunteer
volunteer.text: Give a few hours to chat, give support or help with activities. You don't need to be a teacher: just be willing to listen.

partner.title: Schools, organisations and businesses
partner.text: We work in a network with schools, social services and other organisations. Let's talk about how to collaborate.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: If you can't find the answer you're looking for, write to us. We'll be glad to help.

enroll.a: Write to us on WhatsApp, by email or with the form on this page and we'll explain the steps.

level.q: Do I need to know any Catalan or Spanish?
level.a: No. There's a place for every level, including people starting from zero.

who.a: For women who want to learn Catalan or Spanish (online classes) and for children who need school support or language classes. We also offer services to schools.

volunteer.a: Yes, and we'd love that! You only need a little time and the will to listen. Let's talk.

data.q: What do you do with my data?
data.a: We only use it to reply to you and organise activities. We don't share it with third parties.

online.q: How do the online classes work?
online.a: You'll receive a link to join from your phone, tablet or computer. If you're unsure about the technology, we'll help you.

schools.q: Do you offer services to schools?
schools.a: Yes. We offer school support and language classes for pupils. Write to us and we will see what your school needs.

cta.title: Shall we talk? Your first word can be today
cta.text: Message us on WhatsApp or leave us a note. We'll happily reply in the language that suits you best.

contact.title: How can we help you?
contact.lead: Write to us on WhatsApp, by email or with the form. We'll reply as soon as we can.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This website does not use tracking or advertising cookies. We only process the data you voluntarily give us.

s1.title: Who is responsible
s1.text: Associació Parla i Integra, based in Reus (Tarragona, Spain). You can contact us to exercise your rights or with any question at:

s2.title: What data we collect
s2.text: If you write to us through the form: your name, email, phone (optional), the reason and message, and the site language. If you write via WhatsApp, the message is handled inside WhatsApp and we only see your number and what you write.

s3.title: What we use it for
s3.text: Only to answer your enquiry or manage your registration for our activities. We do not build profiles, make automated decisions or use your data for advertising.

s4.title: Legal basis and retention
s4.text: The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR), given by ticking the form checkbox and which you can withdraw at any time. We keep the data while we deal with your enquiry and afterwards only as long as needed to meet legal obligations.

s5.title: Who we share it with
s5.text: We do not sell or give away your data. The form is sent through the FormSubmit service and received in a Gmail (Google) mailbox; both act as technical providers and may process data outside the EU with appropriate safeguards. If you use WhatsApp, Meta's terms also apply.

s6.title: Your rights
s6.text: You may request access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability of your data by writing to the email above. If you believe we have not handled your data properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).

s7.title: Minors and cookies
s7.text: If you write on behalf of a person under 14, a parent or legal guardian must do so. The site uses no cookies: it only stores the language you choose in your browser, to remember it.
